scientific_integrity: Exact Hurwitz-polynomial algebra and sign arguments are supplied; reproducibility code is same-model symbolic verification and is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-weight unidirectional rings and equal-radius monochromatic traveling-wave classes are classified.
The imaginary-pair crossing is spectral; its nonlinear bifurcation type is not established.
No global basin or full attractor classification is asserted.
Historical priority is provisional: the full 2007 Yanchuk-Wolfrum preprint could not be inspected.
title: Sharp five-site stability threshold and the smallest attracting rotating Stuart–Landau ring
